scope: Recover existing Gleam AGY execution adapters and reconcile Telegram handoff in development

fmea_modes.cause: Telegram identity and payload fields do not prove canonical execution authority

fmea_modes.controls: Authenticated allowlisted ingress, canonical per-request tasks, current leases, scoped dispatch and independently observed refusals

fmea_modes.cause: Shared request deletion or premature processed marking loses or duplicates messages
fmea_modes.effect: Lost operator intent or misleading delivery success
fmea_modes.controls: Durable per-request acknowledgement, explicit uncertain outcomes, bounded retries with stable identity

fmea_modes.cause: Historical component counts and quarantined EV claims substituted for current admission

stpa_analysis.control_action: Accept Telegram intents, deliver truthful bounded results and evaluate current system admission

ucas.constraint: Implement verified bounded operation and visible failure

ucas.context: Caller fields or static handlers masquerade as authorization or execution
ucas.constraint: Verify canonical identity/task and truthful executor result; deny unsupported mutations

ucas.context: Authority expires or changes between admission and execution; release precedes review
ucas.constraint: Fresh effect-time fence and independently reviewed immutable release

ucas.context: Repeated requests outlive task or create duplicate side effects
ucas.constraint: Stable request identity and bounded task lifecycle; no blind retries

decision.summary: Recover existing Gleam AGY execution adapters and reconcile Telegram handoff in development
alternatives: Canonical authenticated dispatch with durable requests: preferred subject to review.
Caller-supplied authority or completed grants: rejected.
Historical EV counts as admission: rejected.
counterevidence: MCP exposes four read-only tools, but compiled Gleam Herdr discovery succeeded and identified idle AGY session954b9a82 in a UOS sibling workspace.
No coordinator lease exists; old task execution labels do not prove active workers.
Source observations do not prove runtime admission.
assumptions: Cooperative local Unix-account trust boundary; no remote IAM claim.
decision.forecast: Scoped changes become independently reviewable; global gates may expose further gaps.
decision.falsifier: Any fabricated success, authority bypass, stale lease execution, or degraded managed runtime
acceptance: Use genuine discovered AGY session; obtain explicit ACK without inventing identity.
Restore bounded Gleam dispatch using canonical Sa-plan and fresh risk/task/resource fences.
Record tool interface, task handoff and remaining gaps; no production effects.
decision.rollback: Preserve main83dca039 and f080822e capsule; runtime rollback needs finite independent review.
decision.reviewer: Independent Codex review; actual AGY implementation peer.
decision.budget: Pinned local tools; bounded development discovery, one hour leases; no package downloads, production changes or Telegram sends.
residuals: Live outbound acceptance requires an explicitly authorized test recipient/message.
Full global admission includes all applicable formal/runtime/provenance gates, not a relabel of component acceptance.
